title: Reach revenue falls as Google traffic slump continues to hit digital income
text: Reach PLC (LSE:RCH), publisher of the Daily Mirror, Daily Express and more than 100 regional titles, has reported a 6.9% fall in group revenue in the first quarter of 2026, with digital income declining sharply as Google search and referral traffic continued to deteriorate.
